Q: Optimizing Month Naming A:

Try using SELECT FROM VALUES instead of CASE WHEN.
It is also better to order the rows using min(order_date) instead of order_date, since the order_date column is not defined after grouping by month.

SELECT  c.column1 AS month, c.column2 as MonthName, COUNT(id) as cnt
FROM orders
LEFT JOIN (VALUES ('01','January'),('02','February'),('03','March'),
                  ('04','April')  ,('05','May')     ,('06','June'),
                  ('07','July')   ,('08','August')  ,('09','September'),
                  ('10','October'),('11','November'),('12','December')
          ) c ON c.column1=strftime('%m', order_date)
GROUP BY c.column1
ORDER BY min(order_date)
